# Independent audit: exact tiny-contained-endpoint law


candidate 1d1be0b22c707856, including
the binary-core extension and the centrally symmetric calibration.
The standard-library verifier reran successfully: 101 planar profile
checks, 5304 coupled cap checks, and 33537 binary isolation checks.
No correction is required.

The defining rho_d is a continuous minimum over all normalized
continuous directions. Its two summands f-Gamma and q are nonnegative.
Vanishing of the first forces a canonical simplex equality direction,
where the second is ((d-1)/(d+1))^d>0 for d>=2. Compactness and affine
invariance therefore give the claimed dimension-only positive constant.
The coefficient-only knot domain is compact and excludes constant
functionals. The planar two-piece formula and its AM-GM minimum
2(sqrt(10)-3)/9 are exact.

The actual endpoint thresholds sum to twice the own-centroid
threshold. If the far T cap is below its reflected support threshold,
it pays at least qV; otherwise A is wholly included. The resulting
min(a,qV) bound has the correct signs, including equality. Combined
with f+q>=Gamma+rho, it pays Gamma V+a for every common tilt.
Vertical caps and arbitrary containing caps are separately covered.

The three integer fibers are exact because (A+T)/2 lies in T.
The finite P_i,Q_i cover is asserted only on the actual integer
source; its displayed coefficient 2 fully includes/excludes the
specified endpoint fibers. Its budgets prove the matching global
upper bound. Moving the canonical threshold to lambda_i(y)>1/m
strictly lowers the own cap at every noncentroid middle point,
while the exposed other bases have strictly smaller certificates.
This establishes the stated unique global maximizer.

For the all-n extension, after flips p=-1_I and q=0. An outside
integer base has some coordinate -1, which forces a convex
representation entirely onto p. Thus the cube plus p is the exact
integer support. Since every continuous generator lies in T, none
of the retained cube fibers enlarges. The restriction of an
arbitrary ambient cap to the p,q,v line retains one scalar tilt.
The two displayed exposure functionals are correct; in particular
delta_w(p)=(2k+3)j+(k+1)s-k>=1 for every nonzero cube vertex w.
Their finite tilts give the exact global upper bound and the same
uniqueness statement at (q,g).

The d=1 law is not obtained from a fictitious positive rho_1.
Reflection gives a centrally symmetric retained measure of mass
V+2a, and the same explicit upper caps match V/2+a. The general
centrally symmetric-body version uses the same argument. Its
upper cover uses finitely many continuous directions and their
negatives; strict slab positivity from the interior center proves
uniqueness even for a nonsmooth K and boundary candidate points.
No equality with Gamma_d is asserted there for d>1.

All source measures use full d-volume. Supporting continuous
boundaries are null, while vertical boundaries are kept closed.
The exact projected/mixed derivative comparison concerns their
different halfspace classes and makes no invalid depth transfer.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
